notes.title: NEW UPDATE is in the works for Huntsman: The Orphanage
notes.notes: Hello fellow Huntspersons, and Happy New Year! We've been listening to feedback, and work has commenced on a whole raft of tweaks, additions and improvements for release in a couple of months - and yes it will  be another free update! Meanwhile, Happy Hunting!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.02 coming soon
notes.notes:
This update is currently being tested, we'll release it as soon as we can. What I can tell you is...

Mementoes will stay where you put them, with no sneaky tricks from the Huntsman or orphans moving them while your back is turned. However, the Huntsman will be hunting you in the maze right from the moment you first enter...

notes.title: v0.9 update just days away!
notes.notes:
Colliders: Hoping no more sticking!
Doors: All doors can be closed again.
Doors: Open/closed state stored on save.
Objects: "Floating" just above floor level: more found and fixed, replaced or removed.
Toys saved state: checked and confirmed to work.
Toy dropping: Fixing toys disappearing when dropped. This might not be an issue if we were to implement a backpack for the player to store the objects in, as some have suggested?

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.notes:
Just finishing the final checks on an update that includes the following fixes:

1. Stick controller settings now correct on default and can be customized.
2. Phone booth rings just once per game.
3. “C” now for crouch, along with the previous L-CTRL.
4. Arrow keys now clone WASD.
5. Walk and run speeds are just a l-i-t-t-l-e faster on walk, bit more on run.
6. Right Shift as well as the previous Left Shift now activate running.
7. Moonlight and torch brightness upped again – torch beam widened and range extended just a little, too.
8. F2 no longer quits the game.
9. ESC now brings up options to return to menu, or 'cancel' to return to game.

We're also testing our new Save and Pause, and our new Moon and Torch brightness level controllers - hopefully ready very soon!
